ANC is defined by measuring the amount of acid needed to change the pH value of the sample to a different chosen amount. The test was performed in Erlenmeyer flasks (containing 1 g battery powder and 100 mL deionized water) to which various amounts of 1.0 M HNO3 were added so as to have disparate pHs ranging from that of the sample to about 4. All flasks were shaken at room temperature for 5 days. After shaking and equilibration, the pH values of the solution were measured."
